body:
Standup notes from DevExp weekly standup (2026-06-10)

Agenda:
- Quick updates from SDK, Docs, Samples, Quickstarts, Telemetry
- Blockers and support needs
- Action items and owners

Notes:
- SDK
  - RC cut for v0.9.0. CI green except for mac wheel packaging (M1). Integration tests: python sdk, node sdk, streaming examples all passing on linux.
  - Performance: microbench shows ~8-12% improvement on cold-start paths with new http connection pooling. Need to validate on dedicated infra.

- Docs / Quickstarts
  - New quickstart generator supports env var auth and streaming snippets. Still missing a simple enterprise example for private deployments; Priya to draft.
  - 'Optimizing for latency' draft uploaded to Confluence; includes batching and KV caching tips but needs concrete numbers and examples (Priya will add).

- Samples
  - chat-demo updated: function-calling flow added, model fallback to smaller variant when heavy load detected. Requires feature-flag gating; Samir to remove internal dependency.
  - New sample for embeddings + reranking in progress; currently a rough prototype.

- Telemetry
  - Minimal event schema landed. Backend team (observability) will provision ingestion capacity next week. Need to confirm GDPR/PII handling before enabling default sampling >1%.

- Support / Requests
  - Release engineering: help with mac wheel (Miguel) and publishing process.
  - Security: review telemetry schema and PII filtering (Asha to engage).

Parking lot / Questions:
- Do we want to publish RC notes with Linux-only binary until mac wheel is fixed? (Decision: yes, with clear note)
- Should quickstarts include a small 'enterprise' note for private deployments? (Decision: include mini example and link to Private docs)

Next steps / Timeline:
- 2026-06-11: Samir PR for sample fallback, Lina finalize release notes draft.
- 2026-06-12: Miguel to report mac wheel status.
- 2026-06-13: Priya edits docs; Asha initial security feedback due 2026-06-14.

Next meeting: Weekly standup on 2026-06-17 09:30 PT

End of notes.
